name: Kamino (Hubble)
blurb: Kamino, a faint isolated dwarf galaxy beyond the Local Group, seen by Hubble.
label: kamino-hubble
story: Kamino is a solitary dwarf galaxy, among the most isolated faint dwarfs known, and it is still forming stars today, with a glowing H II region where new stars are born. Its discovery was first reported from this Hubble imaging.

claims.text: Kamino is one of three isolated faint dwarf galaxies beyond the Local Group imaged by Hubble
Kamino ranks among the most isolated faint dwarf galaxies known
Kamino continues to form stars and shows an H II region
Kamino's discovery is first reported in the Hubble paper
Kamino is a star-forming dwarf galaxy targeted by program 17514
